name: Agency Bulk Upload — Daily Intake
description: Daily agency intake. Fires once per day per onboarded agency at 12:00 America/Chicago. If the agency has NOT uploaded today, one human task reaches out (call / sms via twilio + a real email) and the branch ends. If it HAS uploaded, the object model is built end to end: AI extraction (regex + Gemini) with a human fallback (which also confirms an ambiguous order PDF), patient resolve (create vs update), admission date-gap fill then resolve, episode date-gap fill then resolve, order create vs skip-duplicate, and a record review. AFTER review, post-model billing gates run: episode-eligibility -> make billable/claimable; not eligible -> document / patient-data / signature gates each routing an async remediation human task that the next daily run re-evaluates. AFTER make billable/claimable, the CCN + audit/submit tail runs: CCN generation (Gemini-dead -> human 'Create CCN manually') -> one bounded audit/rework/re-audit cycle (passRate >= 98%?) -> below 98% routes a human 'Resolve audit failures' then a re-audit -> a human 'Submit claim' gate (confirm-only; records submitted_at + amounts; no external call).

groups.name: Contact Agency to Upload Documents
groups.info: Agency has not uploaded today — reach out (call / SMS via twilio + a real email). This branch ends the item.

groups.name: Update / Create Patient Model
groups.info: Agency uploaded — build the object model end to end: AI extraction (regex + Gemini) with a human fallback that also confirms an ambiguous order PDF, patient resolve (update vs create), admission date-gap fill then resolve, episode date-gap fill then resolve, order create vs skip-duplicate, then a record review.

groups.name: Post-Model Billing Gates
groups.info: After the record review, re-derive the episode's state from the real DB rows: eligible -> make billable/claimable; not eligible -> check 485+F2F documents, patient data completeness, and physician signature, each routing an async remediation task the next daily run re-evaluates. (make_billable_claimable appears on both the eligible arm and the signature-pass arm — the DAG cannot converge two branch-walks on one node, and the step is idempotent.)

groups.name: CCN, Audit & Submit Claim
groups.info: After make billable/claimable: CCN generation for the item's billable months (Gemini-dead -> human 'Create CCN manually'), then ONE bounded audit -> rework -> re-audit cycle (passRate >= 98%?); below 98% routes a human 'Resolve audit failures' then a re-audit; then a human 'Submit claim' gate (confirm-only, records submitted_at + amounts, NO external call). The tail is instantiated on BOTH make_billable arms (eligible arm 'a' + signature-pass arm 'b') — idempotent twins, because the frozen DAG cannot converge two branch-walks on a single node; every tail step is agency-scoped and idempotent.

nodes.name: Check agency uploaded today
nodes.description: Look at uploaded_documents for this agency on today's day bucket; stamps agency_uploaded / agency_not_uploaded.

nodes.name: Contact agency to upload the documents
nodes.description: Agency has not uploaded today. Reach out (call / sms route through twilio; email is a real send). Branch ends here.

nodes.name: AI extract (regex + Gemini)
nodes.description: Cost-tiered extraction: regex tier then Gemini for any still-missing fields. Multi-signal PDF<->order match (filename -> order-number-in-text -> patient+date). Ambiguous match stamps pdf_match_ambiguous and routes the fill task. Stamps ai_extraction_success / ai_extraction_fail.

nodes.name: AI extraction failed or PDF ambiguous?
Manually fill missing data
nodes.description: Extraction could not fill enough fields, or the order PDF could not be confidently matched — a coordinator fills the missing patient/order values and, when the PDF is ambiguous, confirms which document belongs to this order.

nodes.name: Update patient
nodes.description: Patient unit found by name + dob + mrn — update the existing unit/record.

nodes.name: Create patient
nodes.description: No patient unit found — create the Patient Unit + Patient Record.

nodes.name: Enter admission dates
nodes.description: SOC (and EOC) are missing — a coordinator enters them so the admission row is written with real dates.

nodes.name: Check / create admission
nodes.description: Resolve the admission by patient + SOC — reuse if it exists, else create it.

nodes.name: Enter episode dates
nodes.description: SOE/EOE are missing — a coordinator enters them so the episode row is written with real dates.

nodes.name: Check / create episode
nodes.description: Resolve the episode within the admission by SOE/EOE — reuse if it exists, else create it.

nodes.name: Skip duplicate order
nodes.description: Order number already exists — leave the existing order untouched and mark this row a skipped duplicate.

nodes.name: Create order
nodes.description: New order number — write the order row attached to the resolved admission/episode.

nodes.name: Review record
nodes.description: Coordinator reviews the assembled patient/admission/episode/order and confirms the checklist. Completing this settles the record review; the post-model billing gates run next.

nodes.name: Check episode eligibility
nodes.description: Re-derive the episode's eligibility from the real DB rows (signed 485 + valid F2F window). Stamps episode_eligible / episode_not_eligible.

nodes.name: Make billable / claimable
nodes.description: Episode is eligible — flip the patient's latest-episode status toward billable/claimable (denormalized). Stamps billable_claimable. Continues into the CCN + audit/submit tail (arm a).

nodes.name: Check 485 + F2F documents exist
nodes.description: Not eligible — check whether both a 485 and an F2F document are present. Stamps documents_exist / documents_missing.

nodes.name: Get missing documents
nodes.description: A 485 or F2F document is missing — contact the agency, run the RPA placeholder, or confirm manually in the EHR. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates this gate and auto-resolves this task once the documents are present.

nodes.name: Check patient data complete
nodes.description: Documents present — sweep the required patient demographics. Stamps patient_data_complete / patient_data_incomplete.

nodes.name: Get and fill patient data
nodes.description: Required patient demographics are missing — a coordinator fills them. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates this gate and auto-resolves this task once the data is complete.

nodes.name: Check physician signature exists
nodes.description: Data complete — check whether every episode order is physician-signed. Stamps signature_exists / signature_missing.

nodes.name: Make billable / claimable
nodes.description: Documents + data + signature all present — flip the patient's latest-episode status toward billable/claimable (denormalized). Stamps billable_claimable. Idempotent twin of n10a for the signature-pass path. Continues into the CCN + audit/submit tail (arm b).

nodes.name: Send for signature to Physician
nodes.description: An episode order is unsigned — mark it 'sent to physician portal' (records SentToPhysician; HUMAN action, no auto-send) and verify / bulk-sign at /pg-login. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates this gate and auto-resolves this task once signed.

nodes.name: Run CCN service
nodes.description: Generate CCN clinical notes for the item's billable CPO months. Gemini-dead => stamps ccn_failed. (Arm a — eligible path.)

nodes.name: Create CCN manually
nodes.description: CCN generation failed (e.g. Gemini unavailable) — a coordinator writes / confirms the clinical notes manually, then the audit cycle runs. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates and auto-resolves this task once notes are present.

nodes.name: Run audit cycle
nodes.description: ONE bounded audit -> rework -> re-audit cycle (<= 5 cycles) over the agency's RCM records; computes passRate and stamps audit_pass_98 (>= 0.98). (Arm a.)

nodes.name: Resolve audit failures
nodes.description: The audit cycle left passRate below 98% — a coordinator confirms / fixes the flagged RCM records, then a re-audit runs. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates and auto-resolves this task once the audit passes.

nodes.name: Re-audit
nodes.description: One more bounded audit/rework cycle after the human resolution; re-stamps audit_pass_98. (Arm a.)

nodes.name: Submit claim
nodes.description: HUMAN GATE — confirm the claim is reviewed and ready. Records submitted_at + the summed claim amount and flips the agency's RCM records to submitted. NO external call. (Arm a — end of the eligible path.)

nodes.name: Run CCN service
nodes.description: Generate CCN clinical notes for the item's billable CPO months. Gemini-dead => stamps ccn_failed. (Arm b — signature-pass path, idempotent twin of n14a.)

nodes.name: Create CCN manually
nodes.description: CCN generation failed (e.g. Gemini unavailable) — a coordinator writes / confirms the clinical notes manually, then the audit cycle runs. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates and auto-resolves this task once notes are present. (Arm b.)

nodes.name: Run audit cycle
nodes.description: ONE bounded audit -> rework -> re-audit cycle (<= 5 cycles) over the agency's RCM records; computes passRate and stamps audit_pass_98 (>= 0.98). (Arm b.)

nodes.name: Resolve audit failures
nodes.description: The audit cycle left passRate below 98% — a coordinator confirms / fixes the flagged RCM records, then a re-audit runs. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates and auto-resolves this task once the audit passes. (Arm b.)

nodes.name: Re-audit
nodes.description: One more bounded audit/rework cycle after the human resolution; re-stamps audit_pass_98. (Arm b.)

nodes.name: Submit claim
nodes.description: HUMAN GATE — confirm the claim is reviewed and ready. Records submitted_at + the summed claim amount and flips the agency's RCM records to submitted. NO external call. (Arm b — end of the signature-pass path.)
